form.label: Cyber Data Catalog - Ingestion Quality
form.description: Line-breaking, timestamp and truncation warnings from splunkd, by sourcetype and host. These are the parsing failures that make data look present while fields and events are wrong. Feeds the same signals as DC-35.

search.query: index=_internal source=*splunkd.log* (log_level=WARN OR log_level=ERROR) (component=AggregatorMiningProcessor OR component=LineBreakingProcessor OR component=DateParserVerbose) | rex "Context: source(::|=)(?<context_source>[^\|]*?)\|host(::|=)(?<context_host>[^\|]*?)\|(?<context_sourcetype>[^\|]*?)\|" | eval data_sourcetype=coalesce(data_sourcetype, context_sourcetype), data_host=coalesce(data_host, context_host) | where isnotnull(data_sourcetype) AND NOT match(data_sourcetype, "^(splunkd|splunk_|stash$|mongod|kvstore)") | eval issue=case(component="LineBreakingProcessor","line breaking", component="DateParserVerbose","timestamp", component="AggregatorMiningProcessor","event truncation / merging") | bin _time span=1h | stats count by _time issue data_sourcetype data_host

panel.title: Warnings over time by issue type

search.query: | search data_sourcetype=*$st$* | timechart sum(count) by issue

panel.title: Sourcetypes with parsing issues - fix the props.conf for these

search.query: | search data_sourcetype=*$st$* | chart sum(count) over data_sourcetype by issue | addtotals fieldname=total | rename data_sourcetype as sourcetype | lookup dc_datasets_lookup sourcetype OUTPUT ae_name declared_tier | eval tenants=mvjoin(mvdedup(ae_name),", "), declared_tier=mvjoin(mvdedup(declared_tier),", ") | fields - ae_name | sort - total

panel.title: Hosts sending them - where the fix is deployed

search.query: | search data_sourcetype=*$st$* | stats sum(count) as warnings, values(data_sourcetype) as sourcetypes, values(issue) as issues by data_host | sort - warnings

panel.title: Indexes with the most sourcetypes - possible sourcetype sprawl

search.query: | tstats dc(sourcetype) as sourcetypes, values(sourcetype) as sourcetype_list where `dc_scope_indexes` by index | eval sourcetype_list=mvjoin(sourcetype_list,", ") | sort - sourcetypes
